create_scene_with_config: create a Scene object from a SceneConfig to prepare the world with animated characters and optional floor
progress_time_in_scene: call progress_time on a Scene to advance all TimeManager objects by delta_t seconds
add_animated_characters: add AnimatedDrawing children to the Scene by listing them in the SceneConfig animated_characters field
add_floor_to_scene: add a Floor object as a child of the Scene by setting add_floor to true in config
add_bvh_visualization: add BVH retarget visualization to the Scene by setting add_ad_retarget_bvh to true in config
